claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Vecuronium is a quaternary ammonium neuromuscular blocker that is not cytotoxic at 2.5 uM; it lacks the lipophilic cationic amphiphilic structure needed for lysosomal stress and does not engage any growth or survival pathway in cancer cells, so it is expected to be largely inactive.
